| # Program flow control {#program-flow-control-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                       |                                                                                                                                                          |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Scheduling/ execution of internal safety/ monitoring functions is monitored with the aid of an external hardware watchdog (monitoring module inside CY32x):

- Execution order.

- Execution frequency.

- Compliance with timing requirements.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

 

- Fundamental error reaction must be independent from CPU. In case of an error the power stages will be switched off by CY326 directly.

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

  Error                          Reaction
  ------------------------------ -------------------
  DFC                            No
  Error Code                     No
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   Yes
  ECU Reset                      Yes
  Reaction time                  200 ms
  Reset Reason - Group ID        RESET_SWRESET_MOC
